what: A band of variable-width cells (full-height photos, cards) joined horizontally and wound endlessly — 10 times one wheel tick (deltaY+deltaX) and 10 times one drag frame (px the hand moved per 30ms) is added to the target, and a 1.5s power3.out tween is overwritten so it glides. The more you roll, the more the target piles up ahead, and when you release it slowly comes to a stop. Chosen options: auto drift (50px per second, no curve), stop within .1s on leaving the window, block click after a drag, opposite-direction parallax of the photo inside a cell (±40px at window width 1920). Cells inside the screen (1.1 times the cell width as margin) get is-fx-near.

options.drag: Drag multiplier, default 10 — if the hand moves 1px to the right, the target moves 10px to the right
options.ease: Curve, default power3.out (also accepts the form ”0.16,1,0.3,1”)
options.auto: Auto-flow speed (px/s, leftward), default 0 — off. With autoplay: on it starts as soon as attached, otherwise the consumer calls el.fxReel.play()
options.autoplay: If ”on”, it flows to auto as soon as it attaches
options.from: Wind range — item (default) gives each cell −cell width to strip length − cell width, view gives −window width to strip length − window width (when laying equal-width cards out past the left edge of the screen)
options.overlap: Overlap between cells (px), default 0 — use .5 to remove hairline gaps between photos
options.parallax: [data-fx-part=inner] parallax strength (px, at window width 1920), default 0 — the closer a cell is to the left edge of the screen, the more its inner photo is pushed +, and the closer to the right edge, the more it is pushed −
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Cells of the strip (width via CSS, if the photo is 100% height, use width:auto)
options.[data-fx-part=inner]: (If present) inner cell shifted by parallax
options.is-fx-hold: If the attached element has this class, it does not receive wheel or drag (when the cover is open or switched to list view)
options.el.fxReel: play(), stop(), glide(px), to(position, duration, curve), measure(), scroll (read/write)

use: …

from.where: detail.html .mi-detail__list — screen-height photos flow by themselves at 50px per second, wheel·drag moves 10x with 1.5s power3.out
product.html .mi-figs__reel: same-width cards, inner photo parallax 40, runs by itself when idle (clock)

note: The original was built with jQuery and lodash throttle — moved to pointer events with the same values. On touch, the strip takes only horizontal gestures via touch-action: pan-y (swiping vertically scrolls the page).
